1.title: Why AI Harnesses Must Separate From Models | Taylor Savage
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Taylor Savage (Factory Head of Product) discusses why AI agents are moving to cloud infrastructure, how orchestration primitives and isolated execution environments replace local setups, and the architectural case for separating harnesses from frontier model providers.

2.title: Why Google Argon Launched to Cyber Defenders First | Tulsee Doshi
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Tulsee Doshi (Gemini product lead at Google DeepMind) walks through Argon's capabilities — 3D modeling, cybersecurity, code optimization, 1M token context window — and Google's rollout strategy including safety monitoring via chain-of-thought. Internal use cases and testing results covered.

1.title: Voice Is the New UI for Physical AI | Brendan O'Driscoll
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Samsara VP of Product on Agent Studio GA — voice agents for fleet/logistics operations, no-code builder, how voice becomes the interface for physical AI systems, proprietary data advantage in enterprise adoption.

1.title: Is Meta’s Muse Wonder model any good?
1.author: How I AI
1.hook: Benchmark evaluation of Meta's Muse Wonder across 20 tasks (coding, agentic workflows, writing, design, video editing); compares performance to Sonnet, Opus, Astra on specific categories; assessment of whether Muse fits into production agent workflows.

2.title: Why AI Agents Will Demand 1,000x More Compute | Aaron Levie
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Aaron Levie on infrastructure scaling for AI agents — why enterprise agent workflows demand 100–1,000x more compute than personal assistants, and bottlenecks in deployment infrastructure.

3.title: Why Frontier AI Models Fail at Biology | Alexander Amini
3.author: MTS
3.hook: Liquid AI's CSO discusses their 24B MoE model (LFM 2.5), the tradeoff between local vs. cloud intelligence for robotics, and research showing specialized foundation models outperforming frontier LLMs on biological aging tasks.
